motions.title: This House Believes that the Government has Failed in the Power Sector in the State Structure
motions.info: A parliamentary inquiry examining national grid expansion, power subsidies, capacity charges, and long-term energy sovereignty.

troops.name: Tahmid Hasan
troops.logic: Universal electrification and strategic mega-projects have created an essential foundation for nationwide economic expansion.

troops.name: Sumaiya Anjum
troops.logic: Grid modernization in rural agriculture and industrial zones has directly multiplied regional production efficiency.

troops.name: Rakib Chowdhury
troops.logic: Long-term capital investments such as nuclear and deep-sea LNG facilities ensure future energy independence.

troops.name: Sakib Al Mahmud
troops.logic: Unsound capacity charge structures and poor contract transparency have imposed an unsustainable fiscal burden on taxpayers.

troops.name: Farhana Yasmin
troops.logic: Persistent summertime outages paired with tariff hikes demonstrate a systemic lack of demand forecasting and policy execution.

troops.name: Anindya Roy
troops.logic: Excessive reliance on imported fossil fuels created vulnerability to foreign exchange shocks and halted generation facilities.

troops.name: Farhan Chowdhury
troops.logic: Capacity charges without demand optimization have strained fiscal balance.

troops.name: Tawhid Hasan
troops.logic: Grid transmission line enhancements have doubled rural distribution reliability.

troops.name: Abrar Rahman
troops.logic: Over-contracted capacity charges create systemic fiscal drag.

troops.name: Mustafizur Rahman
troops.logic: Renewable energy microgrids are solving remote off-grid challenges.

troops.name: Nafis Imtiaz
troops.logic: Systemic transmission loss outweighs generated supply in rural zones.

troops.name: Shahriar Alam
troops.logic: Decentralized solar-grid integrations are delivering energy sovereignty.

troops.name: Sakib Khan
troops.logic: Energy subsidies are distorting macroeconomic stability.

motions.title: This House Holds the United States Responsible for Escalating the US-China Strategic Conflict
motions.info: Examining semiconductor export bans, naval freedom of navigation patrols, and Taiwan Strait deterrence doctrines.

troops.name: Arman Malik
troops.logic: Aggressive decoupling policies and tech containment unilaterally disrupted multilateral trade equilibrium.

troops.name: Zoya Rahman
troops.logic: Defensive alliances and technological safeguards were necessary responses to non-market practices and territorial expansion.
